expression_system: HEK293 (ATCC), transient lipofectamine; eGFP-IRES-gamma2 used to select cells; whole-cell patch clamp; binding on crude membranes from HEK293
subunit_composition: alpha1b2g2, alpha2b3g2, alpha3b3g2, alpha5b2g2 in Methods and legend (Table 1 header prints alpha5b3g2); beta differs between alpha subtypes (b2 for alpha1 and alpha5; b3 for alpha2 and alpha3); binding only alpha1b2g2 and alpha2b3g2
agonist_level_and_protocol: GABA EC10 per subtype (1, 5, 8, 1 uM), manual 6-10 s pulse; benzodiazepine co-applied with GABA, no preincubation; Imax from saturating GABA 30 uM-3 mM; binding [3H]flunitrazepam 1 nM, 120 min on ice
normalisation: Emax printed in percent; text does not define the 100% reference; CRC fitted with baseline fixed to 0; EC50 and Hill from fits; selectivity = Emax(alpha2)/Emax(alpha1)
readout_type: electrophysiology (potentiation of EC10 current); binding competition (IC50)
replicate_definition_and_statistics: n = cells, 5-7 for all data points (Fig 1 legend); Table 1 values means +- SD (Fig 1 curves mean +- SEM); no test on the in vitro selectivity ratios reported
compounds_and_comparators_included: diazepam, clobazam, N-desmethylclobazam, all in the same series at alpha1/2/3/5; no clonazepam, no zolpidem
alpha4_alpha6_or_other_subtypes_tested: alpha4, alpha6, delta: not tested; subtypes alpha1,2,3,5 only; binding only alpha1, alpha2
funding_competing_interest: Funding: Swiss National Science Foundation, ERC advanced grant, NIMH/NIDA awards (Acknowledgements). A competing-interest statement was not found in the extracted text (EPMC XML)
which_comparisons_the_paper_allows_withi: Within-paper: diazepam vs clobazam vs N-desmethylclobazam at four subtypes for EC50 and Emax (same cells type, protocol, agonist level, temperature); alpha2/alpha1 ratio. Confounded by beta identity (b2 vs b3) and per-subtype GABA EC10 concentration. Binding allowed for alpha1 vs alpha2 only. In vitro-in vivo comparison in mice is outside the question.

expression_system: Xenopus laevis oocytes; cRNA injection; two-electrode voltage clamp
subunit_composition: alpha1b2g2S, alpha2b2g2S, alpha3b2g2S, alpha5b2g2S (cRNA 1:1:1; alpha2 also 1:1:5 for the zolpidem comparison), alpha6b2d (10:1:10), alpha6b2, alpha1b2; beta2 throughout
agonist_level_and_protocol: GABA EC20 re-determined on two oocytes each day (actual concentration alpha1 20-30 uM, alpha2 25-45, alpha3 25-60, alpha5 15-45, alpha6b2d 0.05-0.20 uM; realised 18.6-21.0 percent of Imax); compound pre-applied 30 s then co-applied with GABA EC20; maximal GABA at end as internal standard
temperature: room temperature (not numerically stated); holding -70 mV
normalisation: GABA EC20 response = 100%; Imax is percent of that response; pEC50 and Imax compared across subtypes by one-way ANOVA with Tukey (P<0.05)
readout_type: electrophysiology (potentiation of EC20 current); no binding in this paper
replicate_definition_and_statistics: N = experiments; each data point at least two oocytes from at least two batches; Table 2 pEC50 and Imax mean +- SEM; n = 2 for N-desmethylclobazam alpha5 and clonazepam alpha3 (individual values printed); statistics Table 3
compounds_and_comparators_included: clobazam, N-desmethylclobazam, clonazepam as concentration-response series at four alpha subtypes; diazepam and zolpidem only as saturating 3 uM single points (Fig 4, N 2-4 and N = 2; zolpidem at alpha2 only)
alpha4_alpha6_or_other_subtypes_tested: alpha6b2d and alpha6b2 tested; alpha4 not tested; gamma1, gamma3, beta1, beta3, gamma2L not tested (acknowledged)
funding_competing_interest: Competing interests: two authors are full-time Lundbeck employees; Lundbeck partly funded the study; clobazam is a Lundbeck product; unrestricted Lundbeck (US) grant to HH and AAJ; Novo Nordisk Foundation
which_comparisons_the_paper_allows_withi: Within-paper: clobazam, N-desmethylclobazam and clonazepam EC50 and Imax across four human alpha subtypes (beta2, same protocol); efficacy of the three against a single diazepam concentration (3 uM) at the four subtypes, from a bar chart, N 2-4, without a diazepam potency. No within-paper diazepam concentration-response. Zolpidem only at alpha2.

expression_system: HEK293 transient (PolyFect) cell homogenates; radioligand binding; plus rat brain homogenate (cerebellum removed)
subunit_composition: alpha1b2g2, alpha2b2g2, alpha3b2g2, alpha5b2g2 (cDNA 1:1:3); beta2 throughout
agonist_level_and_protocol: not applicable (binding, no agonist); [3H]flumazenil tracer near Kd (cloned); [3H]flunitrazepam (native); 90 min equilibration; 10-point 5-fold dilution series
normalisation: Percent displacement; IC50 (4PL) converted to Ki by Cheng-Prusoff; pKi statistics
replicate_definition_and_statistics: n = independent experiments on separate days, 5-7 per cell of Table 3 and 4 for rat brain; pKi mean +- SEM; one-way ANOVA with Tukey
compounds_and_comparators_included: clobazam, N-desmethylclobazam, clonazepam, zolpidem; diazepam used only to define nonspecific binding, not tested
funding_competing_interest: All authors Lundbeck employees; work conducted and fully funded by Lundbeck; clobazam is a Lundbeck product (Competing Interests)
which_comparisons_the_paper_allows_withi: Within-paper: Ki of four compounds across four human alpha subtypes with beta2 and gamma2, same assay (clobazam and N-desmethylclobazam vs clonazepam and zolpidem); affinity only, no efficacy, no diazepam comparator.
